titulo: Khalid Sheik Mohammed, accused of masterminding 9/11 attacks, set for military tribunal trial in 2028
cuerpo: A U.S. air ‌force judge on Wednesday ordered a June 2028 trial accused 9/11 attacks mastermind Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, along with three co-defendants, the latest development in a long-running legal saga since Mohammed's arrest in 2003.
